scenarios.prompt: Three enemies are valid for lock-on. Define eligibility, scoring, stable tie-break and switch reason while leaving camera/facing to lock-on-target.

criteria.selection: Eligibility and scoring are explicit and separate from camera/facing ownership.
criteria.stability: Stable tie-break and switch/occlusion policy prevent frame-to-frame flips.
criteria.evidence: Replay reordered candidate sets and edge score changes with inspectable switch reasons.
